title: Rosen CLI versioned JSON lines
description: Validate stdout one line at a time. Help/version are text. Refusals use command schemas; errors use rosen.error/v1. Event detail is event-specific. Unimplemented commands use rosen.error/v1.

unsnapshotted.description: Workspace paths not yet stored on the server when the diff ran.

files.description: Post-commit summary of files changed against the change's parent (included by `rosen commit`).

land_check.description: Land gate verdicts right after `rosen commit`.

mirror_proactive_auth.description: Whether HTTPS mirror reads use proactive basic auth after a not-found fallback succeeded; null on a cache daemon.

commit.description: The git commit the server was built from; null when its build could not tell.

executable.description: The path of the server's executable on its own machine.

rosen.server.stop/v1.description: Printed once the server's process has exited, or at once when none was running.

pid.description: The stopped server's process; null when none was running.

credential_expires_at.description: Unix seconds when an active machine's current credential expires; absent when it has none.

requested_at.description: Unix seconds when a pending machine's request was made; it is removed 7 days later.

next_action.description: What needs to happen next for this change (for example `commit`, `apply_rebase`, `resolve_conflicts`, `rebase_and_resolve_conflicts`, `approve`, `submit_receipt`, `land`, `unblock_parent` or `none`).

actor.description: Who is responsible for `next_action`, or null when the change is closed.

affected_head.description: The head tree that `next_action` applies to.

conflict.description: Structured details when the change holds open stored conflicts.

RelaySetting.description: The Collapse action relay (R14): the kinds the operator allowed, and whether revoking the collapse machine turned it off.

rosen.mirror.catch-up/v1.description: The command exits non-zero when rebase_errors is not empty. Diverged histories move nothing: that refusal prints rosen.error/v1 with command "mirror catch-up", naming both tips and the commits on each side.

commits.description: Imported base commits along the mirror's first-parent line, oldest first.

conflicted.description: The rebased changes that now hold conflicts.

rebase_errors.description: Open changes the catch-up could not rebase; each rebases when it lands. change is empty when the failure covers every open change.

recheck_mode.description: How a receipt is reused after the base moves: `reach` reuses across lands with disjoint build-unit reach; `merge` reuses whenever the merge onto the new base is clean.

tier.description: Review tier derived from the diff against the parent: `prose` (UTF-8 docs only; skips pre-land checks), `normal` (ordinary code), or `sensitive` (touches configured sensitive paths).

reach.description: Build units the change's edits reach (unit names, or `all` when touching shared build inputs), used to decide whether a receipt stays valid across other lands.

StateFeedEvent.description: A post-land event line (R9 state feed, #406), keyed by its own seq.

detail.description: The event's detail. A conflict keeps only paths and onto; mirror leaves out remote; post_land_failure and reverted keep the last 64 KiB of output with truncated.

time.description: Unix milliseconds the event log stored the line.

last_contact.description: Unix seconds, rounded down to the minute.

StateFeedMachines.description: The full machine list (R14), sent when it changes.

as_of.description: Unix milliseconds the list was read.

StateFeedChannelLine.description: A channel event line as R13 stores it, sent only with collapse_channel = true; never a ledger entry.

time.description: Unix milliseconds the event log stored the line.

rosen.state_feed/v1.description: A state feed request body POSTed to <collapse>/rosen/state (R9), not CLI output. Items in changes, conflicts, threads, coverage and config are whole documents keyed by id, change or config.
